Class VirtualView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.server.VirtualView
All Implemented Interfaces:
IGameObserver
public class VirtualView extends Object implements IGameObserver
============================================================================ VirtualView — Proxy Pattern between Model and network ============================================================================ --- ROLE: The Game (Model) knows nothing about the network. It has a list of observers (IGameObserver) and notifies an event by calling a method (e.g. onCardPicked) on each observer. --- The VirtualView registers itself as an observer of the Game. When the Game notifies it, the VirtualView translates the call into a network message and sends it on its ClientConnection (Socket or RMI, it does not matter). --- HOW THE BROADCAST HAPPENS: Broadcasting is NOT the responsibility of the VirtualView. Every VirtualView has ONLY ONE ClientConnection and sends ONLY to its own client. Broadcasting happens in the Game: when the Game notifies an event, it does so on ALL registered observers (a for-loop). Therefore: --- Game.pickCard("Alice") -> notifyCardPicked() -> for (IGameObserver obs : observers) obs.onCardPicked() -> VV_Alice.connection.sendUpdate(CardPickedUpdate("Alice")) -> VV_Bob.connection.sendUpdate(CardPickedUpdate("Alice")) -> VV_Carlo.connection.sendUpdate(CardPickedUpdate("Alice")) --- All clients receive the update, everyone sees the updated board. --- DIFF vs FULL STATE: The updates are already "diffs" because they contain ONLY the changed data: - CardPickedUpdate: nickname, row, cardIndex, newFoodBalance - TotemPlacedUpdate: nickname, position - TurnChangedUpdate: nickname etc. The entire state of the game is never sent, only the delta. --- FULL FLOW: Client Request -> SocketClientHandler/RMIClientHandler -> Controller -> Game | notifyXxx() (for-loop) | +----------------+----------------+ | | | VirtualView VirtualView VirtualView (Alice) (Bob) (Carlo) | | | v v v Update Update Update ============================================================================
